title: Racket Stringing Service Status Breakdown
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stringing:service
| stats count as items by service_status
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - items
description: Shows the current mix of racket stringing service records by status so blocked or incomplete work stands out quickly.
value: A status split is the fastest way to explain the shape of the queue without reading every record.
implementation: Keep status names small and well controlled so the split is readable and action-oriented.
visualization: Pie chart or bar chart of current records by status.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how your stringing jobs are spread across waiting, done, and stuck states.
